name: rust_api
description: A full-stack web application featuring an asynchronous REST API built with [Axum](https://github.com/tokio-rs/axum), SQLite persistence via [SQLx](https://github.com/launchbadge/sqlx), Argon2 password hashing with JWT authentication, and an interactive frontend built with React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS (bundled directly into the compiled binary with `rust-embed`).
